reviewed_by: Codex focused review for durable project Assistant defaults
reason: New-chat settings are now stored on the project in Core and restored only for fresh conversations. The selected Core API case covers patch validation, independent fields, durability and project isolation. Seven frontend cases cover runtime fallback plus the Assistant settings modal, new-chat reset, and remount behavior. Eight real-Core production-LAN journeys exercise save, New chat, refresh, and the persisted controls in desktop Chromium and emulated mobile Chromium/WebKit at 320/390/430 px boundaries.
exclusions: No full Python, frontend, native, or Playwright suite was authorized. Existing conversation streaming, provider execution, desktop packaging, and unrelated workspace journeys are excluded because this change only writes project defaults and reads them for unattached chats; existing-session settings remain session-owned. Native code is unchanged. Physical-device browser testing is unavailable; mobile checks are emulated. The real-Core journey uses an inert harness fixture and does not send a model turn.
